criteriaForNine: Retain the current cast, foreground exclusivity and three-moment composition while restoring intentional material separation across the whole frame: soft cream character, controlled wing surfaces, readable wood grain, stone planes, fabric weave and quiet distant foliage.
Verify the repair at native size and 1280/880/420 scales. No broad patchwork treatment on hero or props, no regression of the exact guest-eye constraints, and no new anatomy/contact artifacts.

Keep the foreground moth the first read while reducing competing small texture/highlight noise enough that the workshop and leaf game remain distinct supporting moments. This would earn a new judgment, not an automatic 9.

strengths: The right-hand coder is the unmistakable lead at all three inspected local scales. Guests stay off its bench and the foreground path; four guests form two subordinate groups rather than a logo lineup.

Large near tree and bench frame one continuous park; the curving open path, progressively smaller workshop and distant bridge establish coherent space. Warm upper-right light, atmospheric distance and foreground blur support the intended film-still direction.

Coding, building and resting express a warm maker identity. The three moths retain a recognizable shared family through cream head, compact proportions, paddle antennae and green layered wings; exact pattern equivalence is not proved by this observation.

The bench, stool seats, tabletop and shared leaf provide understandable contact and story relationships at native size. No new guest count or foreground-position defect is visible in the inspected scene.
The magnified eye evidence meets the specified broad dark-Muse/plain-white-Grok distinction; Clawd has two visible square eyes. Those local successes do not cancel the wider finish issue.

baselineComparison: 07 and 11 preserve essentially the same large-scale composition and clear foreground lead. 11 turns the builder more toward the left-hand company and changes the leaf interaction; Grok's white ovals and the darker Muse eyes are clearer in the current evidence. However, 07 has smoother character volume and more differentiated wood, cloth and environmental detail. 11 adds a conspicuous patch/crease character across surfaces and brighter fine texture. I prefer 11's intended local story/eye corrections while asking for 07-level material clarity; neither is automatically the final master.
